title: Named after his father and Saint John
summary: Discussion of why he is called Juan: his father had the same name, and Rose adds they were named for San Juan.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: And you were named after Saint Juan? Right? San Juan?
The reason your name is Juan.
I was named just like my father -- my father was named Juan.
I see, because I read someplace that you were named after the saint, but then, your father probably was, too, right?
Say 'yeah'. You were named after Saint John -- San Juan.
